title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP11d — history candidate report-root fix
goal: Keep Historical Integrity candidate-validation artifacts inside their isolated repository root and prove a valid changed manifest passes.
acceptanceCriteria: The base candidate verifier writes the Historical Integrity report inside its isolated history repository root.
A semantically changed but valid head history manifest passes candidate validation.
A manifest whose recorded evidence hash is wrong still fails candidate validation.
Production inputs, command paths and Historical Integrity verdicts remain unchanged.
